claims.evidence: Witness confirms an office photocopier with document feeder and control panel, but does not show multifunction capability; 'low cost' cannot be verified from photos.
Machine is wrapped in clear plastic on a brown table; the wrapping does not prove the unit itself is clean.
No sample copy, print output, or scan result is shown in the witness report.

risks.proof: Video of the power button being pressed and indicator lights or fan starting.

risks.risk: Copying, printing, or scanning functions fail
risks.proof: Video of a test copy, print, or scan with the output sheet visible.

risks.risk: Toner or ink is empty or near empty
risks.proof: Photo of the toner cartridge or control panel showing remaining levels.

risks.risk: Page count or meter reading is high
risks.proof: Screenshot of the control panel menu showing the meter count.

risks.risk: Age or manufacture year is old
risks.proof: Photo of the nameplate or serial sticker showing the manufacture date.

risks.risk: Power cables or installation guides are missing
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and manuals included with the unit.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and making a test copy
Photo of the nameplate or serial sticker and control panel meter screen
Photo of the toner cartridge and any included cables or manuals
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an office photocopier, so a worst-case price is possible even without brand, model, or function tests; proof can raise the value.
